sources.title: FY2027 Congressional Justification, Policy Development and Research

status_summary: No suspension of PD&R external research and evaluation grants, and no realignment of non-data functions out of the office, was found. HUD's FY2027 budget request, released 2026-04-03, would cut PD&R research and technology funding to $63.0 million from $122.5 million enacted for FY2026, mainly by reducing survey sample sizes, while continuing research partnerships with a 50 percent partner match and launching new evaluations aligned with administration priorities. That request is a parallel budget proposal, not enacted, and it trims the survey work the Mandate would keep.

timeline.event: HUD's FY2027 budget request was released, proposing PD&R research and technology funding of $63.0 million.

title: Suspend PD&R external research grants and narrow the office to data and surveys
uncertainties: The PD&R justification carries no printed date and is labeled undated; the NAHRO account does not give the PD&R figure, which comes from the justification. One targeted web search and the researcher's search of news and HUD pages found no reported grant suspension; staffing reductions were reported only as an early 2025 union estimate. The five systematic absence checks were not all documented.
